name: River of Blood
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the current agenda number.
[tablet] -2. If you fail and are at a [[Lair]] location, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing] -3. If you fail and there are 1 or more [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator, after this test resolves, release 1 of those tokens and take 1 damage.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is 1 more than the current agenda number.
[tablet] -3. If you are at a [[Lair]] location, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing] -4. If there are 1 or more [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator, after this test resolves, release 1 of those tokens and take 1 direct damage.

name: The First Day
text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends: If Julia Stern is at a [[Lair]] location, flip her facedown (discarding all tokens and attachments on her) and place her beneath that location, along with the top card of the encounter deck. Otherwise, if Julia Stern is ready, she moves once toward the nearest [[Lair]] location.
backText:
If there are a total of 2 or more encounter cards beneath locations in play, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag.
One at a time, reveal each facedown encounter card beneath a location. If the revealed card is a treachery, discard it. If it is an enemy, spawn it at the location at which it was revealed (if this effect fulfills the objective on the current act, finish resolving this agenda before advancing the act).
If there are no [[Civilian]] enemies in play, the lead investigator draws 1 of the set-aside Waterfront Civilian enemies.
Ready Julia Stern. She moves once toward the nearest [[Civilian]] enemy.
flavor: Julia Stern is hiding somewhere in the Waterfront District. You'll need to look around and see if you can find the monster's lair before she emerges to kill again.

name: The First Night
backText:
Heal all damage from Julia Stern. For every 2 damage healed this way (rounded down), place 1 damage on the scenario reference card.
Shuffle the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and Julia Stern together. Place these cards facedown, at random, beneath each [[Lair]] location, distributed as evenly as possible.
One at a time, each investigator draws 1 of the set-aside Waterfront Civilian enemies, until no such enemies remain set-aside.
flavor: The light of the full moon casts stark shadows on the streets of Arkham, creating dark corners and shrouded alleys too dim to see into clearly. The light of the streetlamps doesn't seem to reach as far as it should. The sound of someone - or something - scrabbling up the wall of a nearby building sets you on edge. But you know you only have so much time to find Julia, so you steel yourself against the night.

name: The Second Day
text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends: If Julia Stern is at a [[Lair]] location, flip her facedown (discarding all tokens and attachments on her) and place her beneath that location, along with the top card of the encounter deck. Otherwise, if Julia Stern is ready, she moves once toward the nearest [[Lair]] location.
backText:
If there are a total of 2 or more encounter cards beneath locations in play, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag.
One at a time, reveal each facedown encounter card beneath a location. If the revealed card is a treachery, discard it. If it is an enemy, spawn it at the location at which it was revealed (if this effect fulfills the objective on the current act, finish resolving this agenda before advancing the act).
Move all damage from the scenario reference card to Julia Stern.
If there are no [[Civilian]] enemies in play, the lead investigator draws 1 of the set-aside Waterfront Civilian enemies, until no such enemies remain set-aside.
Ready Julia Stern. She moves once toward the nearest [[Civilian]] enemy.
flavor: You're running out of time. If you want to put an end to the threat of Julia Stern, you'll need to act fast.

name: The Final Night
flavor: With every corner you turn, you expect to find another bloody victim of Julia's predatory machinations. The night is mostly quiet, but the sound of a distant scream or the scraping of claws on cobblestone are constant reminders that monsters hide in every shadow.

name: Locate the Lair
text: [action] Investigators at the same [[Lair]] location spend 2 clues, as a group: One at a time, draw each facedown encounter card beneath your location. If you draw Julia Stern this way, place 1 resource (from the token pool) on her, as a snare. Objective - When Julia Stern enters play, immediately advance.
backText: Place clues (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to that location's clue threshold.
flavor: The creature has gone into hiding. You'll need to find her lair and draw it out.

name: Corner the Suspect
text: [action] Investigators at Julia Stern's location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Julia Stern, as a snare. Objective - After Julia Stern leaves play, immediately advance.
backText:
If Julia Stern is not in the victory display:
Julia proves to be a difficult target to pin down. Even when you think you have her, you are surprised to find that she is quick to slip away into the shadows once more.
Reset the act deck to Act 1a.
If Julia Stern is in the victory display:
After hours - days - of struggling, you finally bring Julia down. She lies in a crumpled heap on the cobblestones, her breathing ragged as she barely clings to consciousness.
The investigators must decide (choose one): - "There might still be hope for her." (→R1) - "We need to put an end to this monster." (→R2)
flavor: Julia Stern is on the loose, and it is clear she is no longer human. She stalks the streets of Arkham looking for victims. You'll need to work fast and slow her down to stop her from killing again.

name: Water Street
text: [action]: You go looking for help. Search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Water Street
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from this location: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.

name: Garrison Street
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are no enemies at this location: Move to a connecting location.
flavor: Garrison Street is one of Arkham's busiest avenues, as it is one of the few streets to span the Miskatonic River.

name: Garrison Street
text: While there are 1 or more enemies at Garrison Street, it gets +1 shroud.
flavor: Garrison Street is one of Arkham's busiest avenues, as it is one of the few streets to span the Miskatonic River.

name: River Docks
text: [action] Investigators at River Docks spend 3 resources, as a group: You hire a captain to take you to the island. Each investigator at this location may move to Unvisited Isle. For the remainder of the game, River Docks is connected to Unvisited Isle.

name: River Docks
text: [action] Investigators at River Docks spend 5 resources, as a group: You hire a captain to take you to the island. Each investigator at this location may move to Unvisited Isle. For the remainder of the game, River Docks is connected to Unvisited Isle.

name: Main Street
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are no enemies at this location: Move to a connecting location.

name: Main Street
text: Forced - After you discover the last clue from Main Street: You must either draw the top card of the encounter deck, or choose the nearest [[Monster]] enemy to move once toward the nearest [[Civilian]] enemy.

name: Erwin Bridge
text: Forced - After you fail a fight or evade test at this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage, disengage from each enemy, and move to Unvisited Isle.

name: Erwin Bridge
text: Forced - After you fail a fight or evade test at this location: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 direct damage, disengage from each enemy, and move to Unvisited Isle.

name: Unvisited Isle
text:
As an additional cost to leave Unvisited Isle, you must spend 1 action.
[fast] If there are no clues on Unvisited Isle, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: Remember that "the investigators found a sacrificial dagger."
backText: While enemies are moving, Unvisited Isle is considered to be connected to River Docks, and vice versa.

name: Unvisited Isle
text:
As an additional cost to leave Unvisited Isle, you must spend 1 action.
[fast] If there are no clues on Unvisited Isle, add 2 [blood] tokens to the chaos bag: Remember that "the investigators found a sacrificial dagger."
backText: While enemies are moving, Unvisited Isle is considered to be connected to River Docks, and vice versa.

name: Waterfront Warehouse
text: [action] If there are no clues on Waterfront Warehouse and no facedown encounter cards beneath it, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: You set fire to the warehouse. Each investigator and enemy at this location moves to a connecting location. Add Waterfront Warehouse to the victory display.

name: Waterfront Warehouse
text: [action] If there are no clues on Waterfront Warehouse and no facedown encounter cards beneath it, add 2 [blood] tokens to the chaos bag: You set fire to the warehouse. Each investigator and enemy at this location moves to a connecting location. Add Waterfront Warehouse to the victory display.

name: Back Alley
text: [action] If there are no clues on Back Alley and no facedown encounter cards beneath it, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: You perform a ritual to cleanse the alley. Each investigator and enemy at this location moves to a connecting location. Add Back Alley to the victory display.

name: Back Alley
text: [action] If there are no clues on Back Alley and no facedown encounter cards beneath it, add 2 [blood] tokens to the chaos bag: You perform a ritual to cleanse the alley. Each investigator and enemy at this location moves to a connecting location. Add Back Alley to the victory display.

name: Julia Stern
text: Elusive. Patrol (nearest [[Civilian]] enemy). Predator. Julia Stern gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When damage would be dealt to Julia Stern: Remove 1 snare from her. If you cannot, reduce that damage to 0.

name: Julia Stern
text: Elusive. Patrol (nearest [[Civilian]] enemy). Predator. Retaliate. Julia Stern gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When damage would be dealt to Julia Stern: Remove 1 snare from her. If you cannot, reduce that damage to 0.

name: Julia Stern
text: Elusive. Patrol (nearest [[Civilian]] enemy). Predator. Retaliate. Julia Stern gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When damage would be dealt to Julia Stern: Remove 1 snare from her. If you cannot, reduce that damage to 0.

name: Waterfront Civilian
text: Aloof. Doomed. Spawn - Any empty [[Arkham]] location. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, set this enemy aside, out of play.

name: Burning Daylight
text: Revelation - If the current agenda is 1a or 3a, place 1 doom on it (this can cause the current agenda to advance). Otherwise, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, draw 1 random set-aside [[Monster]] enemy.

name: Detective Reynolds
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Detective Reynolds: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Discover 1 clue from your location or a revealed connecting location.

name: Fang of Zburamoarte
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to reveal 2 chaos tokens for this skill test instead of 1 (resolve both tokens). This attack deals +1 damage for each [blood] token revealed during this test.

name: New Horizons
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the current act number.
[cultist] -1. If there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, reveal an additional token. After this test resolves, release 1 [blood] token sealed on you.
[tablet] -3 (-5 instead if there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator. After this test resolves, release 1 [blood] token sealed on you).
[elder_thing] -4. If you fail and there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, take 1 damage and release 1 [blood] token sealed on you.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is 1 more than the current act number.
[cultist] -2. If there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, reveal an additional token.
[tablet] -3. If there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, you automatically fail instead.
[elder_thing] -4. After this test resolves, if there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, take 1 damage and release 1 [blood] token sealed on you.

name: Busy Day
backText: Spawn the set-aside Javier Rivera enemy engaged with the investigator with the most clues.
flavor: You find your way into the meat packing facility through the back entrance, coming in through the loading dock. You provide vague answers to workers who question your presence, just enough of an excuse to get them out of your hair for the moment. You're sure it's only a matter of time before someone with authority comes to demand answers, so you'll need to investigate the factory as best, and as fast, as you can.

name: Quiet Night
backText: Spawn the set-aside Night Watchman enemy at the Factory Floor nearest the most investigators.
flavor: You find your way into the meat packing facility through the back entrance, coming in through the loading dock. After you break in through the locked door, you find the warehouse to be quiet and dark. Silvery moonlight streams in from the high windows to illuminate parts of the factory floor, but you can't shake the feeling that something is hiding in the shadows, watching you.

name: Digging Deeper (v. I)
flavor: The more time you spend in the facility, the more you believe that there is a sinister secret lurking in every dark corner or behind every locked door. You've met some resistance so far, and it would've been wise to turn back, but you can't put aside the feeling that if you don't get to the bottom of this, then Julia Stern will only have been the first victim of whatever is going on.

name: Digging Deeper (v. II)
flavor: The more time you spend in the facility, the more you believe that there is a sinister secret lurking in every dark corner or behind every locked door. You've met some resistance so far, and it would've been wise to turn back, but you can't put aside the feeling that if you don't get to the bottom of this, then Julia Stern will only have been the first victim of whatever is going on.

name: To New Horizons
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R1). Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Storage may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
backText: Put the set-aside Cavern Entrance location into play. Search all in- and out-of-play areas for all 4 copies of the Factory Worker enemy and remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Flying Terrors encounter set and each copy of the set-aside Echoing in Darkness treachery into the encounter deck.
flavor: The New Horizons facility is one of the more recently constructed buildings in Arkham. The clean windows and crisp brick facade present a welcoming exterior, but your instincts tell you that not all is as it seems.

name: The Search for Answers
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R1). Objective - At the end of the round, if there are exactly 2 clues on this act, advance.
backText: Put the set-aside Descending Tunnel location into play.
flavor: The tunnels below the New Horizons facility are dark, mostly dirt and stone. The only light is the occasional dim glow of candles or a lone electric lantern. You must be on the right track.

name: Bring Down the Beast
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R2). Objective - If Zburamoarte is defeated, advance.
flavor: There is only one place you haven't yet investigated in the tunnels. The path winds ever downward, and you can feel a breeze and hear the trickle of water. It seems it leads to a great chamber of some sort. Whatever is down there, it must be the source of all of this tainted blood.

name: Factory Floor
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Each investigator at this location loses 1 resource.

name: Factory Floor
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Each investigator at this location chooses and discards 1 card from their hand.

name: Manager's Office
text: [action]: Add one exhausted enemy at this location to the victory display. Each other enemy and investigator at this location moves to Factory Floor (West). Remove this location from the game (or, if there are no clues on it, add it to the victory display instead).
backText: Investigators cannot enter Manager's Office unless "the investigators stole the manager's keys."

name: Loading Dock
text: [action]: Resign. You leave the factory behind. [fast] If there are no clues on this location, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: Remember that "the investigators found forged permits." (Group limit once per game.)

name: Storage
text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate this location, instead of discovering clues: Draw 2 cards. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Factory Floor
text: Forced - After you discover the last clue from this location: You must either add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag, or place 1 doom on the current agenda.

name: Factory Floor
text: Forced - After you discover the last clue from this location: You must either add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag, or draw the top card of the encounter deck.

name: Manager's Office
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Manager's Office, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: Remember "the investigators found a sheet of arcane symbols." (Group limit once per game.)
backText: Investigators cannot enter Manager's Office unless "the investigators found the manager's keys."

name: Loading Dock
text: [action]: Test [combat] (3) to force the loading door open. You may place 1 doom on the current agenda to decrease the difficulty of this test by 2. If you succeed, for the remainder of the scenario, this location gains: "[action]: Resign."

name: Storage
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Storage, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: Remember that "the investigators found the manager's keys." (Group limit once per game.)

name: Cavern Entrance
text: Forced - When this location is revealed: Put each set-aside copy of Side Chamber into play.

name: Cavern Entrance
text: [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put a set-aside Side Chamber location into play, at random.

name: Zburamoarte's Lair
text: Forced - When Zburamoarte's Lair is revealed: Spawn the set-aside Zburamoarte enemy here. Add 2 [blood] tokens to the chaos bag. [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Fight. You attack Zburamoarte. This attack is automatically successful and deals +1 damage.

name: Hidden Laboratory
text: [action]: You learn about vile experiments using the blood of a fearsome monster. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the current act. Then, test [intellect] (4). If you fail, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag. (Group limit once per game.)
backText: As an additional cost to enter Side Chamber, investigators at Cavern Entrance must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

name: Locked Chamber
text: [action] Investigators at Locked Chamber spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You learn something recently broke out of this room. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the current act. (Group limit once per game.)
backText: As an additional cost to enter Side Chamber, investigators at Cavern Entrance must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

name: Secret Chamber
text: Forced - When Secret Chamber is revealed: Spawn 1 of the set-aside Blighted Worker enemies, exhausted, at this location (if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, spawn 2 of those enemies, instead). Shuffle each remaining Blighted Worker enemy into the encounter deck.
backText: As an additional cost to enter Side Chamber, investigators at Cavern Entrance must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

name: Hidden Laboratory
text: [action] Add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag: You learn about vile experiments using the blood of a fearsome monster. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the current act. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Locked Chamber
text: [action] Investigators at Locked Chamber spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: The investigators learn something broke out of this room. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the current act. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Secret Chamber
text: Forced - When Secret Chamber is revealed: Spawn each set-aside Blighted Worker enemy at this location. [action]: Test [agility] (X), where X is the number of ready enemies at this location. If you succeed, disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Zburamoarte
text: Massive. Predator. Retaliate. Zburamoarte gets +3 [per_investigator] health and cannot move. Forced - After this enemy deals damage: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Zburamoarte
text: Alert. Massive. Predator. Retaliate. Zburamoarte gets +3 [per_investigator] health and cannot move. Forced - After this enemy deals damage: Heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from it.

name: Zburamoarte
text: Alert. Massive. Predator. Retaliate. Zburamoarte gets +3 [per_investigator] health and cannot move. Forced - After this enemy deals damage: Heal 4 damage from it.

name: Javier Rivera
text: Doomed. Hunter. Each investigation and parley test at this enemy's location gets +2 difficulty. [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (4). If this enemy is exhausted, this test automatically succeeds. If you succeed, remember "the investigators stole the manager's keys."

name: Night Watchman
text: Hunter. Predator. Prey (most clues). Retaliate. Forced - After an investigator discovers 1 or more clues: If Night Watchman is exhausted, ready it. Otherwise, it disengages from each investigator and moves once toward the location at which the clue was discovered.

name: Factory Worker
text: Doomed. Patrol (nearest location with no [[Elite]] enemies). Factory Worker's location gets +1 shroud. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard this enemy.

name: Blighted Worker
text: Hunter. Forced - After Blighted Worker attacks you, if there are no [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator: Search the chaos bag for a [blood] token and seal it on you. If you cannot, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

name: Echoing in Darkness
text: Revelation - Put Echoing in Darkness into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you draw and resolve another treachery from the encounter deck, discard Echoing in Darkness: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Echoing in Darkness.

name: Sanguine Song
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. As an additional cost to activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to reveal 2 chaos tokens for this skill test instead of 1 (resolve both tokens). If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue for each [blood] token revealed during this test.

name: Forged Permit
text: [fast] Discard Forged Permit: Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, ignoring its resource cost. You may resolve an [action] ability on that asset, ignoring its [action] cost.

name: Blood Money
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is 1 more than the number of [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator.
[cultist] -2. If you fail during an attack or evasion targeting a [[Monster]] enemy, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag.
[tablet] -3. If you fail and there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -4. If you fail, ready the nearest exhausted [[Monster]] enemy.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is 2 more than the number of [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator.
[cultist] -3. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion targeting a [[Monster]] enemy, after this test resolves, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag.
[tablet] -4. If you fail and there is a [blood] token sealed on your investigator, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -5. If you fail, ready the nearest exhausted [[Monster]] enemy.

name: Party Without a Host
text: Each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card gains victory 0.
backText:
If Julia Stern is set-aside, spawn her at Dining Hall (otherwise, spawn 1 of the set-aside Spawn of Zburamoarte enemies instead).
Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all in-play areas for 1 [[Civilian]] enemy and add that enemy to the victory display (2 [[Civilian]] enemies instead if playing on Hard or Expert difficulty).
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 [per_investigator] [[Civilian]] enemies. Spawn each of these enemies at a different location (with no investigators, if able).
flavor: You've arrived at the party in the middle of dinner, with most of the guests in the dining hall. You can feel eyes on you, even when other guests aren't looking your way...

name: Feeding Frenzy (v. I)
text: Each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card gains victory 0.
backText:
For each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card in the victory display, spawn 1 of the set-aside Child of Blood enemies, exhausted, at the location with the most investigators. For each enemy you cannot spawn, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag instead.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each remaining set-aside Child of Blood enemy into the encounter deck.
flavor: The blighted workers of New Horizons have found their way here. Did they come of their own volition? Or did you inadvertently lead them here?

name: Feeding Frenzy (v. II)
text: Each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card gains victory 0.
backText:
For each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card in the victory display, spawn 1 of the set-aside Child of Blood enemies, exhausted, at the location with the most investigators.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each remaining set-aside Child of Blood enemy into the encounter deck.
flavor: The blighted workers of New Horizons have found their way here. Did they come of their own volition? Or did you inadvertently lead them here?

name: Under a Blood Moon
text: Forced - After a [[Civilian]] or [[Cultist]] enemy is defeated via the predator keyword: Remove the defeated enemy from the game. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Monster]] enemy and spawn it, exhausted, at the defeated enemy's former location.
backText: Each investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated.
flavor: The monsters are beyond reason as they horrifically consume the panicked guests. The party quickly descends into madness.

name: Deal or No Deal
text: [fast] Choose a ready Suspicious Guest enemy at your location and spend either 1 clue or 2 resources: Parley. ([codex] A). Objective - At the end of the round, if Priscilla Thomas is not in play, advance.
backText: Put the set-aside Master Bedroom into play. If the Balcony is set aside, also put it into play. Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to its clue threshold. Shuffle each set-aside [[Cultist]] enemy and each copy of the Sanguine Rebirth treachery into the encounter deck. Release each chaos token sealed on each enemy in play.
flavor: The host of the party is nowhere to be found, but the party continues nonetheless. This is your opportunity to learn what you can from the other guests, and maybe convince Ms. Thomas to abandon her partnership with New Horizons.

name: Where Is Wilkes?
text: Objective - After an investigator enters the Master Bedroom, immediately advance.
backText: Spawn the set-aside Howard Wilkes enemy at the Master Bedroom. Check your campaign log. If the investigators defeated Zburamoarte, exhaust Howard Wilkes and disengage him from each investigator. Otherwise, he attacks each investigator at Master Bedroom. Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to that location's clue threshold. Flip the Foyer to its (Bloody Night) side. If agenda 1a is in play, advance it immediately.
flavor: With Priscilla Thomas out of the way, you can now focus on finding Howard Wilkes and taking him into custody.

name: Bloodbath
text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to automatically succeed. If you succeed, move each [[Civilian]] enemy at your location to a connecting location. Objective - If Howard Wilkes is defeated, immediately advance. Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, immediately advance.
backText:
If this act advanced because Howard Wilkes was defeated:
After a long and bloody struggle, you manage to put Howard Wilkes down for good. You hope that this nightmare will finally be fully behind you.
(→R1) If this act advanced because each surviving investigator has resigned:
You manage to escape from the party with your life. You can only hope you've saved enough of the guests and delayed Howard's plans long enough to make a difference.
(→R2)
flavor: Howard Wilkes has finally arrived. You can either try and save as many guests as possible before you make your escape, or face down Howard and bring this nightmare to an end.

name: Foyer
text: [action]: Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to its clue threshold. [action]: Resign. You never were a party person.
backText: [action]: Place a [[Civilian]] enemy at this location beneath the scenario reference card. [action]: Resign. You escape with your life.

name: Dining Hall
text:
Each enemy at this location gets +1 fight and -1 evade.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more at this location: Deal 1 damage to that enemy. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Study
text: Forced - After you fail an investigation at this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: A modestly sized room, the study, much like the rest of the penthouse, is remarkably clean.

name: Master Bedroom
text: The first treachery drawn from the encounter deck at this location each mythos phase gains surge.
backText: As an additional cost to enter this location, investigators at the same connecting location must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

name: Kitchen
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from this location: Each investigator at this location takes 1 direct horror.
flavor: In the corner of the small kitchen, you spy an opened box stamped with the logo of the New Horizons factory.

name: Office
text: [reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues from this location: Gain twice that many resources, instead. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: Papers are scattered everywhere. Books and documents lie in uneven stacks on every flat surface. Howard is nowhere to be seen, but there still may be something useful to find in here.

name: Balcony
text: [action]: Choose a [[Humanoid]] enemy at this location and test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, test [agility] (4). If you succeed, test [combat] (5). If you succeed, defeat the chosen enemy and Balcony gains the [[Crime Scene]] trait until the end of the game.

name: Priscilla Thomas
